protocol: Same settled 1k corpus; closed/open/open/closed, fresh API per phase, browser kept open on blank in closed phases. Real 200-node-limit memory page and fullscreen hologram in open phases, normal page polling retained. Three cycles per phase; each cycle uses the unchanged three recall workloads and 21 canonical queries per worker, discarding each first. Browser events are pumped while recall workers run. Normal 30-second polling remains active; no timing samples discarded beyond the declared warmups.
